Gold Bar

A gold ingot specially sealed for trading.

Obtainable by defeating a stage boss

Dropped on boss kill (BossKillItemRate) in 380 Stages.

⚠ Wiki estimate, not confirmed in-game. This chance is our assumption that BossKillItemRate uses the same 1/1,000,000 scale as the other drop rates in Stage_table. If the game actually uses 1/10,000, the real chance is 100× higher.
